'''Harrin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Harrin sector/Legends|same name]]. It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] and served as the endpoint of the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

Harrin was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]; however, it was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Harrin was a member world of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
Harrin was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Harrin system/Legends|Harrin system]],<ref name="CSWE Harrin" /> a part of the [[Harrin sector/Legends|Harrin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Harrin" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC Harrin" /> It lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Moorja system/Legends|Moorja]] and [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul systems]]. Harrin was also situated at the endpoint of the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]], which connected it to the [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]].<ref name="TEA Harrin" />

==History==
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Harrin was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> Harrin became a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]. By the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the planet fell within the territory known as the [[Corellian Hegemony]], which was economically dominated by the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Harrin fell within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA Harrin" /> and during the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Nineteenth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy in the surrounding space. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Harrin was situated in the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The population of the Harrin [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered from 1 billion to 10 billion.<ref name="TEA Harrin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harrin was first mentioned in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Within the book, the planet was mentioned in a section authored by [[Stephen Crane]].<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Harrin system, and therefore the planet Harrin, in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA Harrin" />
